coaching.headline: Down 1-4 at their Fangtooth by minute 7 with three lane reads against us — and we flipped it on three big fight wins: 3-0, 4-0, 5-1.
coaching.team: The early game was theirs (Fangtooth 8 and 15, a 0-3 bad trade at 2.7 chasing Skylar with no objective up), and carry, mid and jungle all read behind. The comeback was structural: from 19 minutes we took Mini Prime, Fangtooth, both Genesis spawns and both Primals, and the fights swung big — 3-0 at our Fangtooth at 20.5, 4-0 at their Orb at 25.4, 5-1 at our inhibitor at 32.7. Two things to trim: three won fights went uncashed (11.8, 20.5, 28.8), and the 21.4 bad trade (0-3 in our half) plus two fights opened with bodies already down (22.4, 23.1) kept the door open longer than needed.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 20.5-minute 3-0 at our Fangtooth ended their momentum, and the 25.4 4-0 at their Orb Prime rolled straight into our Primal Fangtooth at 27 — making the 32.7 closing fight a formality.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Legion's lane read Skylar's all game (he finished 14/5) and the 10.4 catch by Dekker made it harder — but 8/5 with 10.3k objective damage out of a losing read is the profitable version of a bad lane. The 21.7 death preceded their inner tower at 23.1, and Vanquisher was the missing core piece; both are cheap fixes on a winning formula.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Steel's 21 wards and the late-game frontline made the flip possible — the support lane was our only read that went from even to ours, and the 25.4 and 32.7 wins had Steel anchoring both. The cost side: 6 deaths, and the film prices three of them (6.6 before their Fangtooth, 18.2 before a tower, 24.4 before their Orb). Fewer solo exposures, same fights.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
ourKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
ourKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power

enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down

enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain
